lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 88, which puts a 5 pixel gap between the search entry and the Include subfolders toggle.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request 88, which puts a five pixel gap between the search entry and the Include subfolders toggle.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
You press Ctrl+F, and the location bar becomes a search entry.
lines.say: You press control F, and the location bar becomes a search entry.

lines.caption: While a search runs, the Include subfolders toggle shows at the entry's right end.
The one new line gives the toggle a 5 pixel margin on its left.
lines.say: The one new line gives the toggle a five pixel margin on its left.

lines.caption: The entry gets 5 pixels narrower, so the toggle now has 5 pixels on both sides.
lines.say: The entry gets five pixels narrower, so the toggle now has five pixels on both sides.

lines.caption: The new test searches, captures the window, and measures both gaps on rows of pixels.
It does that in three toolbar layouts, and checks the toggle still hides and still works.
The toggle from issue 21 had a gap on its right, but was glued to the entry on its left.
That right gap is the location bar's own 5 pixel margin, so the toggle gets the same on its left.
lines.say: That right gap is the location bar's own five pixel margin, so the toggle gets the same on its left.

lines.caption: Searching and showing the toggle work exactly as before.
The margin is set where the toggle is created, and it is the whole gap, as the box has no spacing.
The entry stretches, so it gives up the space; the toggle and the gap to the search button stay the same.
The test opens a folder with two matching files, searches for match, and measures the gaps on the shot itself.
It sorts each pixel into bright or dark, and fails unless both gaps are 5 pixels, give or take one.
lines.say: It sorts each pixel into bright or dark, and fails unless both gaps are five pixels, give or take one.

lines.caption: Then it repeats with the menu bar hidden, and in the header bar, where the right gap is 15; each restart waits for the old Thunar to leave.
lines.say: Then it repeats with the menu bar hidden, and in the header bar, where the right gap is fifteen; each restart waits for the old Thunar to leave.

lines.caption: When idle, one colour must run from inside the entry across the toggle's place, and a click must re-run the search without the subfolder.
On one row of pixels, it looks for the dark inside of the entry, then the entry's bright border.
Then a dark gap, the bright toggle, and another dark gap; both gaps are measured.
And last, the bright search button.
ImageMagick prints the pixels as text, and a short awk script groups them into runs.
With the menu bar shown, the left gap goes from 0 to 5 pixels, and the right one stays 5.
lines.say: With the menu bar shown, the left gap goes from zero to five pixels, and the right one stays five.

lines.caption: With the menu bar hidden it is 5 and 5; in the header bar, 5 and 15.
lines.say: With the menu bar hidden it is five and five; in the header bar, five and fifteen.

lines.caption: This is the whole change to Thunar: one line.
The gap on the toggle's right is also a margin, so its left gap is built the same way, and you kept this line.
In the header bar, the gap to the search button stays 15 pixels, as reported on the PR.
lines.say: In the header bar, the gap to the search button stays fifteen pixels, as reported on the PR.

lines.caption: To undo it, revert this PR; nothing is stored in settings.
The PR changes one source file and adds its test, this page and its narration.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
It follows the location bar's 5 pixel margin, issue 68's measurement, and the header bar's 15 pixels.
lines.say: It follows the location bar's five pixel margin, issue 68's measurement, and the header bar's fifteen pixels.

lines.caption: In this session it built, and all 8 existing tests passed, before the new test was written.
lines.say: In this session it built, and all eight existing tests passed, before the new test was written.

lines.caption: Re-run after the review fixes, the new test measured 5 and 5 pixels twice, and 5 and 15 in the header bar.
lines.say: Re-run after the review fixes, the new test measured five and five pixels twice, and five and fifteen in the header bar.

lines.caption: The toggle stayed hidden when idle, and a click changed it and re-ran the search without the subfolder.
Both checks were shown to fail: on an image with the gap cut out, and the new idle check with the toggle showing.
After the fixes the shot check passed; before them, an auditor agent found all 4 screenshots right.
lines.say: After the fixes the shot check passed; before them, an auditor agent found all four screenshots right.

lines.caption: On the latest head, CI's build, explainer and review jobs passed, and all 9 tests passed.
lines.say: On the latest head, C I's build, explainer and review jobs passed, and all nine tests passed.

lines.caption: The visual audit of CI's shots passed, with all 5 shots right.
lines.say: The visual audit of C I's shots passed, with all five shots right.

lines.caption: Main's glued toggle can't be shot, as CI installs only this build.
A fresh review agent found three things, all in the test script, and all were fixed.
The medium one: the idle check could never catch a toggle that is always shown. Now it can.
The paste wait now lets the copy finish, and a compare error no longer counts as a change.
CI's first review, at level high, found 8 things: 6 are fixed, and you accepted R6 and R7.
lines.say: C I's first review, at level high, found eight things: six are fixed, and you accepted R six and R seven.

lines.caption: R1, the missing explainer, is fixed by this page; for R2, the click check now crops before it compares.
lines.say: R one, the missing explainer, is fixed by this page; for R two, the click check now crops before it compares.

lines.caption: R3 and R4: the idle check samples no colour now; R5: restarts wait for D-Bus; R8: gaps are measured on the shots.
lines.say: R three and R four: the idle check samples no colour now; R five: restarts wait for D bus; R eight: gaps are measured on the shots.

lines.caption: R6 and R7 are accepted: the line stays as the issue asked, a margin like the one on the button side.
lines.say: R six and R seven are accepted: the line stays as the issue asked, a margin like the one on the button side.

lines.caption: Two more CI reviews followed, on the fix pushes, with findings R9 to R20.
lines.say: Two more C I reviews followed, on the fix pushes, with findings R nine to R twenty.

lines.caption: R9 to R12, about shot captions, a failure message and extra convert calls, were all fixed.
lines.say: R nine to R twelve, about shot captions, a failure message and extra convert calls, were all fixed.

lines.caption: CI's own fix commit fixed R16, captions describing the whole window, and R17, captions with fixed pixel counts.
lines.say: C I's own fix commit fixed R sixteen, captions describing the whole window, and R seventeen, captions with fixed pixel counts.

lines.caption: R13 to R15 are low and unconfirmed, so they count as accepted.
lines.say: R thirteen to R fifteen are low and unconfirmed, so they count as accepted.

lines.caption: R18 to R20 are accepted with a trailer: none of them changes a check or what a shot shows.
lines.say: R eighteen to R twenty are accepted with a trailer: none of them changes a check or what a shot shows.

lines.caption: After the merge, look at the gap in your own theme; the tests use only one.
The pull request, its checks, the CI runs, the shots and their audit verdict are linked here.
Part 3. Nothing depends on issue 68, so only a look in your own session remains.
After the merge, search in your own folders and click the toggle.
In short: the Include subfolders toggle now stands 5 pixels clear of the search entry, as from the search button.
lines.say: In short: the Include subfolders toggle now stands five pixels clear of the search entry, as from the search button.
